data.name: Edwin
data.gender_notes: Edwin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old English Ead (wealth) and Wealh (friend). The name means 'rich in friend'. In Old English texts, the name was written as Ēadwine. In Middle English, it was written as Edwyn, Edwynne, Edwynn, or Eadwyn. The name was brought to England by the Anglo-Saxons. The name Edwin carries the meaning “Rich in Friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Edwin usually hope their child will grow to embody rich in friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reminds us of the importance of friendship in our spiritual journey.
data.etymology: Edwin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Rich in Friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Edwin total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: אדווין
in_hebrew.meaning: אדווין משמעות: ידיד נדיב, חבר עשיר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אדווין הוא שם פרטי שמקורו באנגלית עתיקה, מורכב משני חלקים: 'ead' שפירושו 'שגיד' או 'נדיב', ו-'wine' שפירושו 'חבר' או 'עשיר'. השם אדווין מתאר אדם שהוא חבר נדיב או שגיד עשיר. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים והוא קשור לערכים של נדיבות וידידות.

in_greek.name: Έντουιν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Έντουιν προέρχεται από την αγγλική γλώσσα και αποτελείται από δύο μέρη: 'ead' που σημαίνει 'ευγενής' ή 'πλούσιος', και 'wine' που σημαίνει 'φίλος'. Το όνομα Έντουιν εκφράζει την έννοια του ευγενούς φίλου ή του πλούσιου συντρόφου. Στην χριστιανική παράδοση, το όνομα Έντουιν συνδέεται με τις αξίες της φιλίας και της γενναιοδωρίας.

in_latin.name: Edwin
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Edwin origine Anglosaxonum, ex duobus constat: 'ead' quod significat 'dives' seu 'generosus', et 'wine' quod significat 'amicus'. Nomen Edwin significat amicum divitem aut generosum socium. In traditione christiana, nomen Edwin refertur ad valores amicitiae et liberalitatis.

in_english.name: Edwin
in_english.long_meaning: The name Edwin originates from Old English, derived from two elements: 'ead' meaning 'prosperous' or 'wealthy', and 'wine' meaning 'friend'. Edwin signifies a wealthy friend or a prosperous companion. In Christian tradition, Edwin is associated with values of friendship, generosity, and prosperity. The name has been in use among Christians and is connected to the biblical principles of kindness and companionship.

data.cultural_impact: The name Edwin gained popularity in Europe during the Middle Ages, where it was borne by several rulers and saints. One of the most famous bearers of the name was King Edwin of Northumbria, who was converted to Christianity in the seventh century by Saint Aidan. Edwin was known for his patronage of the Church and his role in spreading Christianity throughout his kingdom. Additionally, there are several towns and cities named after Edwin in England, including Edwinbury, Edwinstone, and Edwinstow.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Edwin is rooted in Old English, and its meaning 'rich in friend' reflects the Christian values of community, friendship, and generosity. In Christianity, the concept of friendship with God is a fundamental aspect of spiritual growth and development. The name Edwin can be seen as a reminder of the importance of cultivating a deep and abiding relationship with God, who is our greatest friend and source of abundance. Additionally, the name can inspire us to be generous and supportive of others, just as a wealthy friend would be. Ultimately, the name Edwin invites us to reflect on the richness of our spiritual connections and the importance of nurturing them in our daily lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Edwin: "God's friend"; derived from Old English 'Ead' (wealth, fortune) and 'Wynn' (friend). A name evoking trust, loyalty, and divine companionship.
